newsitem.title: USA: US Plains feedlot market to swing on weather - trade.
newsitem.headline: US Plains feedlot market to swing on weather - trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets next week were seen largely controlled by the weather, feedlot sources said.
If forecasts for continued extreme cold and possible snow storms next week prove accurate, the weather could underpin fed cattle prices, feedlot sources said.

Cattle this week sold at $65.00 per cwt, down $1.00 from last week. Early weakness was somewhat tempered by outlooks for extemely cold weather to sweep into the Plains late this week, which generated brisk packer buying, the sources said.
Most weekly showlists were sold and feedlots were current. Several feedyards sold cattle from next week's list to meet the strong demand, they said.
